name: The Strand at Huebner Oaks
summary: The Strand at Huebner Oaks is a community shopping center strategically located along San Antonio's premier Huebner Road retail corridor. Managed by Whitestone REIT, this well-regarded property serves the affluent Northwest submarket with a convenient mix of retail, dining, and service tenants.
demographics: The Strand at Huebner Oaks serves an affluent suburban San Antonio market in the Northwest corridor, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The primary trade area includes residents from nearby Stone Oak, Shavano Park, and the greater Huebner Road corridor, characterized by well-educated homeowners aged 35-65 with families. Shoppers in this area demonstrate preferences for convenience-oriented retail, quality dining options, and service-based tenants that cater to busy suburban lifestyles.
description: The Strand at Huebner Oaks is a well-positioned community shopping center located along the highly-trafficked Huebner Road corridor in San Antonio's thriving Northwest submarket. Owned and managed by Whitestone REIT, a publicly-traded real estate investment trust specializing in community-centered retail properties, this center serves as a convenient neighborhood destination for the surrounding affluent residential communities. The property benefits from its strategic location in one of San Antonio's most desirable retail corridors, offering excellent visibility and accessibility to a strong demographic base. With operating hours from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, The Strand at Huebner Oaks provides a mix of retail, dining, and service tenants that cater to the everyday needs of local residents and the area's growing professional population. The center maintains a strong reputation with a 4.4-star rating from over 1,200 reviews, reflecting its quality tenant mix and well-maintained facilities that have made it a trusted shopping destination in Northwest San Antonio.
